attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Delaware military retirement exemption (2025). Flat $12,500 exemption (no age requirement). Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card, DE Division of Revenue.

initial_action.action_postfix: "DE Military Retirement Exemption Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.de_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.de_military_retirement_taxable xdef

action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay result.de_military_retirement_exemption_amount min /result.de_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.de_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.de_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"DE military retirement exemption: $" result.de_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.de_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.de_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.de_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No DE military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Delaware state income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure with 7 brackets per DE Division of Revenue (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Delaware Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.de_state_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly
Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_comment: Calculate DE tax for Single filers using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.de_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max dup /de_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /de_tax xdef
de_taxable_income result.de_bracket_1_limit min result.de_bracket_1_rate mul /de_tax xdef
de_taxable_income result.de_bracket_1_limit gt { de_taxable_income result.de_bracket_2_limit min result.de_bracket_1_limit sub result.de_bracket_2_rate mul de_tax add /de_tax xdef } if
de_taxable_income result.de_bracket_2_limit gt { de_taxable_income result.de_bracket_3_limit min result.de_bracket_2_limit sub result.de_bracket_3_rate mul de_tax add /de_tax xdef } if
de_taxable_income result.de_bracket_3_limit gt { de_taxable_income result.de_bracket_4_limit min result.de_bracket_3_limit sub result.de_bracket_4_rate mul de_tax add /de_tax xdef } if
de_taxable_income result.de_bracket_4_limit gt { de_taxable_income result.de_bracket_5_limit min result.de_bracket_4_limit sub result.de_bracket_5_rate mul de_tax add /de_tax xdef } if
de_taxable_income result.de_bracket_5_limit gt { de_taxable_income result.de_bracket_6_limit min result.de_bracket_5_limit sub result.de_bracket_6_rate mul de_tax add /de_tax xdef } if
de_taxable_income result.de_bracket_6_limit gt { de_taxable_income result.de_bracket_6_limit sub result.de_bracket_7_rate mul de_tax add /de_tax xdef } if
de_tax /result.de_state_tax xdef de_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Delaware tax calculated (Single): $" result.de_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
